card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

mechanism: A insists B stop physical key searching and proceed only through the theory of emotionally withdrawn invisible keys.
confusable: Unlike simply asking an apology to an object, A must eliminate the remaining ordinary search strategy.
comparison: The sofa search is replaced with trust and apology, unlike interpreting selective light as grounds to cancel an electrician.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
